04 / Know whyA low price needs a little proof.

LOW PRICE.
OPEN EYES.

Confidence comes
from evidence.

BuyLess checks what’s behind an offer and tells you what’s still unknown. No magic authenticity promises. Just a clearer decision.

01The right product.+

Brand, model, capacity, variant, condition, and region must match. A cheaper different model belongs in a separate comparison.

02The price you actually pay.+

Compare eligible coupons, observed shipping, and known fees. Missing delivery costs stay visible. Cashback is separate from the money payable today.

03The seller behind the listing.+

Check seller identity, relevant reviews, manufacturer-backed authorization, warranty, returns, and buyer protection. A seller’s claim alone is not proof.

04The limits of the evidence.+

Online research cannot guarantee a physical item’s authenticity or a worldwide lowest price. BuyLess reports the lowest comparable cost among checked offers and flags gaps.

Research gets deeper when the risk gets higher.

Buying, paying, contacting sellers, and reserving remain separate actions that need your explicit instruction.

Explore on GitHub ↗

Bring BuyLess
to the AI you use.

You’ll need an AI host with web search or browser tools for current prices. BuyLess adds the shopping research skill; your host provides the tools.

Read installation & compatibility ↗

Add the public repository as a marketplace, then install:

codex plugin marketplace add alfahricireng12/buyless
codex plugin add buyless@buyless-community

Open a new supported host session after installation. Plugin and web-tool availability depend on your host.
